Al validar un cargue de <b>Churido o Ucr: When validating an upload for Churido or Ucrania, each row of the Z_HistPrecios_Churido sheet with a semester other than 1 or 2 appears as an error with its Excel row number, and the upload cannot be confirmed until it is fixed. The rule only applies to the companies assigned to that sheet in the Upload Sheets Manager catalog (today Churido and Ucrania). It is installed with Sql/025_sp_ValidarCargueStaging_SemestreHistPrecios.sql.
La tabla resume la prueba de la regla co: The table summarizes the test of the rule with those sample values. If there are more than 200 invalid rows, the first 200 are listed along with a summary of the rest.
Antes de generar el informe se puede ele: Before generating the report you can choose the color palette in the “Report styles” section: Bufins (the usual one, by default), the company’s corporate colors 1 and 2 (if they were registered in the company manager) or a custom one.
La elección se aplica al pulsar <b>Gener: The choice is applied when you press Generate and changes the chart series, the heat map, the PDF band and the headers and charts of the Excel and the email.
No se recuerda: cada vez que se abre el: It is not remembered: every time the report is opened it goes back to Bufins.
El logo de la empresa, la marca Bufins y: The company logo, the Bufins brand and the rise (green) and drop (red) colors do not change.
La cadencia es <b>semestral</b> (S1 = en: The cadence is semiannual (S1 = January–June, S2 = July–December), the same as the original Excel.
Un precio de <b>0 o vacío</b> se trata c: A price of 0 or empty is treated as “no price” (like the empty cell in the Excel): it does not enter averages or charts. That is why Tercera 2015 appears from 2016.
El valor anual de un tipo es el <b>prome: The annual value of a type is the average of its semesters; the “Grand total” is the average of all the records of the period, as in the Excel.
Si un año tiene un solo semestre cargado: If a year has only one semester loaded (e.g. 2026 in part), its average is provisional and the report says so.
Los precios son <b>USD por caja</b>: la: Prices are USD per box: the currency is not stored in the table, but it is taken from the axis of the original Excel chart, and the report labels it that way.
